export interface UnreadCounter {
  count: number;

import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';
import type { RequestOptions } from '../../core/transport.js';
import type {
  UnreadCounter,
} from '../models.js';

/**
 * Operations tagged `Inbox`.
 */
export class InboxResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * Unread counter served under three spellings at once
   *
   * The platform's GET /notifications/unread returns `count`, `unread_count` and `unreadCount`
   * in one object (routes/notifications.ts:238, measured 2026-09-10). Every emitter must keep
   * all three as distinct fields even where its naming convention folds two of them together.
   *
   * `GET /inbox/unread`
   *
   * Required scopes: `inbox:read`.
   */
  getUnread(options?: RequestOptions): Promise<UnreadCounter> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: '/inbox/unread',
      options,
    });
  }
}
